SY415
Sociology of Health, Illness and Gender
0.5 Credit
By drawing on a rich, multiperspectival, interdisciplinary body of research, this
course
examines the complex relationship amongst gender and opportunities for health and likeliness of illness. Topics include gender and medicine, sexuality, experiences across the life course, issues of mental health and others.
